_doc: Golden gross-return fixture for cpp/tests/test_tsmom_backtest.cpp, exported from the reviewed Python implementation (tsmom.py) by export_tsmom_backtest_fixture.py. Idle-capital risk-free credit and turnover cost are excluded on both sides (see module docstring). Sessions before warmup_start exist only to give the C++ side correct warmup; only [compare_start_date, last date] is actually compared.
